placeabout.heading: About this place
placeabout.description:
The Lake Grounds offer a simple combination of grass, water views and places to play. You can keep a visit centred on lunch outdoors or add a short stroll once the picnic is packed away.

Our family idea: choose a spot well back from the water and look for birds from your blanket. Bring a windproof layer; a sunny day beside the estuary can still feel cool.

placepracticalinfo.heading: Practical information
placepracticalinfo.bestFor: Families wanting a picnic with a gentle walk and play stop.
placepracticalinfo.facilities: Open lawns, play equipment and nearby sports facilities.
placepracticalinfo.parking: Use signed Lake Grounds parking and observe current restrictions.
placepracticalinfo.goodToKnow: Keep children close around the lake. The adjacent outdoor swimming pool has separate admission and seasonal opening.
